title: Mano Hub
script:
local WindUI = loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://github.com/Footagesus/WindUI/releases/latest/download/main.lua"))()
local LocalizationService = game:GetService("LocalizationService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- Detecção do País do Usuário
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local countryCode = "US" -- Padrão de segurança

pcall(function()
    countryCode = LocalizationService:GetCountryRegionForPlayerAsync(LocalPlayer)
end)

-- Define se é um país de língua portuguesa
local isPortuguese = (countryCode == "BR" or countryCode == "PT")

local Window = WindUI:CreateWindow({
    Title = "Mano Hub - Answer or Die",
    Icon = "rbxassetid://81836294907110",
    Author = "Sae",
    Folder = "ManoHub",
    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(550, 420),
    Transparent = true,
    Theme = "Dark",
    SideBarWidth = 190,
    HasOutline = false,
    HideSearchBar = false, -- Pesquisa habilitada
    ScrollBarEnabled = false,
    User = {
        Enabled = true,
        Anonymous = false
    },
})

Window:EditOpenButton({
    Title = "Mano Hub - Open",
    Icon = "monitor",
    CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6),
    StrokeThickness = 2,
    Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30), Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)),
    Draggable = true
})

-- Função auxiliar para criar as abas dinamicamente
local function AddAnswerTab(titlePT, titleEN, icon, answerCode)
    local tabTitle = isPortuguese and titlePT or titleEN
    local tab = Window:Tab({ Title = tabTitle, Icon = icon })
    tab:Code({ Title = answerCode, Code = answerCode })
end

-- 1. Um dia da semana
